acceptanceCriteria: The versioned UTF-8 declarative .justtones JSON format preserves exact valid numeric semantics, stable identities, Unicode metadata, dependencies, and catalog references without executable payloads.
Validation enforces declared resource limits before mutation; preview and conflict results remain cancelable and invalid input cannot partially import or disclose user content in logs.
Export is semantically deterministic, the registered document type is JustTones-specific, scoped access is released, and released schema rules and examples are documented.
component: Shared document schema, validation, import/export, conflict-result model, document-type integration, schema documentation, and deterministic fixtures.
componentsAffected: Shared document schema, validation, import/export, conflict-result model, document-type integration, schema documentation, and deterministic fixtures.
notes: No cloud service, arbitrary synthesis code, automatic playback, Watch synchronization transport, or EP-005 presentation implementation.
rationale: No cloud service, arbitrary synthesis code, automatic playback, Watch synchronization transport, or EP-005 presentation implementation.
testSteps: Record JT-TEST-013 through JT-TEST-017, JT-TEST-165 through JT-TEST-181, and JT-TEST-190 through JT-TEST-191 results with schema artifacts.
